# Preparation failures are atomic: the target never starts.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp malformed-fixture malformed.env
exec runprobe write-size oversize.txt 65537
exec sesam add raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt
rm raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt

! exec sesam run --env-file malformed.env -- runprobe mark started-malformed
stderr 'invalid byte in unquoted value'
! exists started-malformed
! exists malformed.env

! exec sesam run --secret LARGE=oversize.txt -- runprobe mark started-oversize
stderr 'exceeds 65536 bytes'
! exists started-oversize
! exists oversize.txt

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- command-that-does-not-exist
stderr 'find command.*using inherited PATH'

exec chmod +x bad-exec
! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- ./bad-exec
stderr 'exec command.*exec format error'
exec runprobe no-temp-files
exec sesam id
stdout '^admin$'

exec runprobe status sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe exit 23
stdout 'exit=23 signal=0'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

exec runprobe status sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe signal
stdout 'exit=143 signal=0'
exec runprobe no-temp-files

! exec sesam run -- runprobe mark started-no-selector
stderr 'at least one --secret or --env-file is required'
! exists started-no-selector

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-invalid-mapping
stderr 'must be VARIABLE=path'
! exists started-invalid-mapping

! exec sesam run --secret BAD-NAME=raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-invalid-name
stderr 'invalid secret variable name'
! exists started-invalid-name

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --
stderr 'a command is required after --'

! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt runprobe mark started-no-separator
stderr 'a command is required after --'
! exists started-no-separator

# Inherited names are never overwritten.
env RAW=parent
! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-collision
stderr 'RAW.*collides with inherited environment'
! exists started-collision
exec runprobe no-temp-files

-- raw-fixture --
raw
-- malformed-fixture --
GOOD=value
BAD=two words
-- bad-exec --
not an executable format
